diagnosis: While the route uses PatientAuthGuard to ensure caller authentication, getLabResults fetches lab results directly by recordId without scoping the Prisma query to the authenticated patient's account (req.user.patientId). An attacker can view confidential medical diagnostics and biomarker records belonging to other patients.
exploit_request:
GET /health/records/rec_lab_582910/lab-results HTTP/1.1
Host: health.careportal.com
Authorization: Bearer <patient_token>
